accessLocation: Old U.S. 421 River Park, Yadkin River, North Carolina
decisionScope: The North Carolina Wildlife Resources Commission lists Old Us Hwy 421 Park on the Yadkin River at 36.1323,-80.4439, exactly matching both route endpoints, and classifies the location as bank/canoe access. Forsyth County confirms a concrete river-access ramp at the public park and documents permanent public access to the Yadkin. Imagery places the point in the park approach/parking area, not at a clearly visible ramp toe. I registered the official access point as a route-scoped site anchor and preserved the offset for exact-entry review.

change.rationale: NCWRC publishes the exact public canoe/bank access coordinate, and the managing county confirms a concrete ramp at the park. The sources establish the access area but not the ramp-toe coordinate.

remainingUncertainty: Both endpoints remain about 344 feet from the matched Yadkin flowline and 263 feet from mapped water. The coordinate is an authoritative public access-site point, not a verified river-entry toe. Confirm the exact ramp/landing location and carry before treating the endpoints as on-water coordinates.
outcome: Two suspicious endpoint occurrences moved to review with the water offset retained. Coordinates and route geometry did not change.
